'''2011 Worlds Day 2 Brian Hollingsworth LS Quiet Mining Colony''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Brian Hollingsworth]] at [[2011 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Line 1 AFA (V); start [[Quiet Mining Colony]] at L2. L18 Home Safe (V); L21 Dashade (V); L31 Pucumir Thryss (V) (sheet Pucum Puc). L44 Strike Planning (V) (sheet Strike Force). L46 SATM+BP → Sorry About The Mess & Blaster Proficiency. L55 It's A Hit (sheet Fly a hit). Shield3 OPTA → Only Prophecy Tells All (V).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Quiet Mining Colony]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
